text:
Maria: FYI PR #6199 is ready for review — implements async batching fallback and platform hooks. I need runtime + infra + security sign-off before merging this week. https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/6199
Kevin: Thanks Maria — can you drop a 2-line summary of the change and any behavioral impact on routing?
Maria: Short summary: 1) adds per-model fallback to smaller-quantized variant when queue latency > 120ms; 2) exposes a new config key `routing.fallback_threshold_ms`; no schema change to customer API, only internal routing behavior.
Sam: I can take runtime look tomorrow morning. Heads-up: perf tests on the branch are flaky — CI showed a throughput regression in one run.
Maria: Noted. CI failures attached below. It's a noisy perf test failure, but I included a small mitigation: reduced batch size default from 128 -> 96 behind a flag.
Kevin: Do we need platform infra changes (k8s rollout / configmaps) for the new flag?
Liam: @Maria quick q: does the change require a configmap migration or new secret? If it's only a default value in code, infra shouldn't need to change. If you introduce a new config key we'll need a patched helm chart.
Maria: It's a new config key (optional). I added a helm values snippet in the PR. Example:
```yaml
routing:
  fallback_threshold_ms: 120
```
No secrets.
Tara: I'll do a security scan tomorrow. Two things I need: 1) threat model update for fallback behavior (what data flows to the alternative model), 2) any changes to KMS/HSM usage.
Maria: Fallback model is a read-only inference variant, same model weights, no additional logging. No KMS changes. I'll add a short threat-model note to the PR.
DeployBot: [CI] Build #6199.5 — checks passed (unit/tests). Perf suite: 1 failed, rerun queued.
Sam: After CI rerun, if perf passes I'll focus on the kernel selection logic (look at `runtime/router.go` lines ~210-260). Also please add a small perf regression test in `eng-runtime/tests/perf` so we can catch flakiness.
Maria: Will add the perf test and the threat-model note today.
Aisha: Merge window question — Ops prefers merges to staging on Tue 09:00 PT. Can we get approvals by EOD Monday so QA has time?
Kevin: I can prioritize platform review this afternoon.
Liam: Infra review done: helm diff looks fine, no schema bump required. 
Tara: Security: quick pass done, no issues found with data exfiltration; left one minor comment around logging verbosity (don't log model selection decisions).
Sam: Runtime: LGTM with one nit on a comment and a small refactor suggestion. I'll leave an inline review now.
Maria: Thanks everyone — assigning reviewers in the PR: @Sam @Liam @Tara @Kevin. I'll address the nit and the security logging comment tonight. Aiming to merge Tue 09:00 PT if CI is stable and approvals remain. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: [PR] Merge blocked — requires reviewers: Sam, Liam, Tara, Kevin.
Maria: I'll follow up here after I push fixes. Appreciate the quick turnarounds.
